blurb: GA Firing Line offers firearms rental packages themed around popular video games and historical periods, allowing guests to shoot various firearms with included magazines. They also provide Form 1/SBR consultation services to assist with ATF paperwork for firearm modifications. Classroom and conference room reservations are available for certified instructors and educators.
extraNote: One-time free reschedule if notified more than 24 hours before appointment; otherwise must purchase new appointment · Cancellation requires rescheduling if documents not complete · Shipping firearms must comply with carrier and ATF regulations; no USPS for serialized parts · Limited 90-day warranty on gunsmithing work covering defects in material or workmanship · 2727 Canton Rd. Suite 410, Marietta, GA 30066
